title: Cranberry Quince

items.item: fresh or frozen cranberries (do not thaw; 3½ cups)

instructions: Peel, quarter, and core the quinces, reserving the peel and cores, then cut the quarters into ¼-inch pieces. Tie up the peel and cores in cheesecloth.

Bring the water and sugar to a boil in a 4-quart heavy saucepan, stirring until the sugar is dissolved. Add the quince and the cheesecloth bundle and simmer, partially covered, until the quince is tender, about 1½ hours.
Add the cranberries and simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the cranberries burst and soften, 8 to 10 minutes.

Drain the mixture in a large medium-mesh sieve set over a bowl, discarding the cheesecloth bundle and reserving the cranberry solids. Return the cooking liquid to the pan and boil, uncovered, until syrupy and reduced to about 1½ cups, 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir together the syrup and cranberry mixture in a bowl, then cool to room temperature.
notes: Special equipment: an 8-inch square of cheesecloth; kitchen string. Active time: 30 min; start to finish: 2½ hr. Makes about 5 cups.
